items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Fontana was there and Rosolino and Al Grey. [INTERVIEWEE] Al Grey. That's another trombone player there, too.

ctx.x: In New York, at a club there.
Yeah. Well, one of the times I was there, it was the first time, they thought Trummy didn't come back. And he did sound good. Fontana was there and Rosolino and Al Grey.
Al Grey. That's another trombone player there, too. He's a young guy.
